title: Tracker integrity's CLAUDE.md version check is unscoped, matches the first narrative version mention instead of the managed block
description: Discovered while landing QCLI-332 (0.8.0 release prep): .github/workflows/tracker-integrity.yml's 'CLAUDE.md's declared Quest version matches this package' step extracts the declared version with sed -n 's/.*Quest CLI ([0-9][0-9.]*).*/\1/p' CLAUDE.md | head -1 -- unscoped to the managed block between the quest:agent-instructions markers. CLAUDE.md's own profile prose (this repo's fleet-operating narrative) legitimately mentions historical version numbers in running text, e.g. line 512's 'Ten repositories declaring Quest CLI 0.7.1 while lore sits at 0.7.0 is correct, not a fleet-wide dangling reference' -- a true historical statement, not a drift signal. That line sits above the actual managed block and its 0.7.1 wins head -1, so the job fails with 'The managed block declares Quest CLI 0.7.1 but package.json is 0.8.0' even when the managed block correctly declares 0.8.0. Reproduced directly: after regenerating the managed block via quest agents --update-instructions against a freshly built 0.8.0 binary (block correctly reads 0.8.0 at line 645), the CI step still failed on PR #182 (run 35283235713) quoting 0.7.1, while the block-scoped extraction (sed -n between the begin/end markers first, then the version regex) correctly returns 0.8.0 locally. This is a reproducible defect in the check, not a usage mistake -- it contradicts its own documented purpose (checking the managed block, not the whole file) and will recur on every future version bump where any earlier narrative text in CLAUDE.md mentions the outgoing version.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The version-check step in .github/workflows/tracker-integrity.yml scopes its sed extraction to the text between the quest:agent-instructions:begin/end markers before applying the version regex

A deliberate violation (a stale managed-block version) still fails the step, and a clean tree with a narrative pre-mention of an old version number passes it -- both measured, not just the fix applied
Landed on dev and confirmed green on QCLI-332s branch after merging dev back in
